stories.title: Live chickens, unsanitary conditions force temporary closure of St. Clair County carpool lot
stories.summary: MDOT temporarily closed a public carpool lot near I-94 to address unsanitary conditions, including chickens living among illegally parked camper vehicles.

stories.title: Michigan woman charged with stalking Eminem allegedly believing she has a family with him
stories.summary: A 46-year-old Trenton woman is charged with stalking the rap superstar Eminem, allegedly believing she is in a relationship with the star and has a family with him.

stories.title: Research poll shows Americans are optimistic about Democrats' control of Congress
stories.summary: A new research poll shows that most Americans are optimistic about the next Congress and approve of the Democrats' leaders' plans.

stories.title: Stocks plunge as investors take cover amid growing uncertainty
stories.summary: The Dow tumbled 1,100 points, while other stock markets also swooned, as Wall Street frets over AI growth and other market risks.

stories.title: Michigan is known for its water, but fecal pollution likely exceeds limits in 75% of its rivers
stories.summary: Republicans and Democrats call the pollution unacceptable for a state so rich in water, but they disagree on solutions. One lawmaker blames lobbying by polluting industries. Another says "we're broke."

stories.title: Woman set free after murder conviction tossed 26 years later
stories.summary: Tashiena Combs was convicted of first-degree murder and was sentenced to life in prison, and is now being released after 26 years.

stories.title: Aidan Hutchinson says 'That's the last time I go airborne' about his season-ending injury
stories.summary: Detroit Lions edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson said, "That's the last time I go airborne," in a statement issued after Coach Dan Campbell confirmed that the Pro Bowler suffered a torn ACL.

stories.title: Trump returns to Washington after meeting with Russian and Chinese presidents
stories.summary: President Trump has arrived at the white house after a historic meeting with the Russian and Chinese presidents, with a news conference set for noon Friday.

stories.title: Aidan Hutchinson says 'That's the last time I go airborne' about his season-ending injury
stories.summary: Detroit Lions edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson said, "That's the last time I go airborne," in a statement issued after Coach Dan Campbell confirmed on Tuesday that the Pro Bowler suffered a torn ACL.

stories.title: Detroit Metro Airport expects over 4 million passengers during holiday travel season
stories.summary: Over 4 million passengers will go through Detroit Metro Airport from November 20 through January 3, DTW says.

stories.title: Furry Friday: Meet Kenji and Lily the cats; and Jasmine the dog
stories.summary: Michigan Humane presents three of the animals that are available for adoption from its shelter care. They are Kenji and Lily, who are a bonded pair of cats; and Jasmine the dog.

stories.title: Trump criticized after calling Putin a friend
stories.summary: President Trump called Russian President Vladimir Putin a friend, sparking a rebuke, amid the wrap-up of a trilateral meeting in China.
